Sumit Gaba · Advocate

Legal practice in Delhi

Sumit Gaba is an advocate practising in Delhi under the name ONS Gaba & Associates.

The office is located in Shubhash Nagar, with court chambers at Tis Hazari and Dwarka. The practice includes civil litigation, property matters, and family and matrimonial proceedings.

For enquiries about a matter or a chamber visit, please contact the office using the telephone details provided. Official court links are also available for case information, cause lists and published orders.
